prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” lawyer for every car accident case. The right choice depends on the injuries, disputed fault, insurance coverage, and the lawyer’s experience with cases like yours.

A reasonable starting point is to compare a few Atlanta attorneys who handle **plaintiff-side car accident cases**. For example, Super Lawyers lists Atlanta attorneys in its [car accident directory](https://attorneys.superlawyers.com/motor-vehicle-accidents/georgia/atlanta/); its listings are a place to research, not a guarantee that any one lawyer is best for your case. You can also contact the [Atlanta Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service](https://atlantabar.org/?pg=lrishome) at **404-521-0777**. It says a consultation fee of $45 may apply.

Before hiring anyone, ask who will personally handle your case, how many similar cases they’ve taken to settlement or trial, how fees and case expenses work, and how often you’ll get updates. Check the lawyer’s license and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of Georgia](https://www.gabar.org/public/find-a-lawyer), and speak with more than one firm if you can.
